why: Items 1, 2 and 4 are handled. 1: builder step 7, "Run `npm install` at the root so `package-lock.json` includes the new workspace". 2: builder step 6, "replace the "No tools yet" bullet". 4: Check 6 reads the PR body and headRefOid with gh and checks the test workflow run at the head commit. Item 3 is not handled. Check 4 runs `cd packages/jsonl-lint && node --test`, which tests the workspace on its own, not under the root script. The mutation test appears only under "Advisory (not pass/fail conditions)" and isn't tied to the root npm test.
